question: By whose agency and to what extent does the yoginī named Icchā operate?
premises: Her operation extends up to māyā by supreme will.
inference: The yoginī Icchā, associated with the siddhas, operates up to the limit of māyā by supreme will.
uncertainties: The syntactic relationship between siddhaiḥ and the rest of the verse is ambiguous.
plain_english: The yoginī named Icchā, by the siddhas and by supreme will, extends up to māyā.
